summary: 30-foot pole L-4 tower on the St. Joe NF, built 1938 and destroyed 1958; a 2024 visit found footings and remains, and no source gives public-access rules.

facts.status_note: The tower was destroyed in 1958; a 2024 visit found footings and remnants on site. FFLA lists the tower as Gone.

events.note: 30-foot pole L-4 tower; footings in a 2024 visit carry a 1939 date
Idaho Fire Lookouts site visit, post dated October 29, 2024; footings, wood stove remnants, wire and two benchmarks found

corrections.why: The tower was destroyed in 1958, but Idaho Fire Lookouts found footings and other remains on site in 2024. The vocabulary value 'Footings or remains only' fits better than 'Gone'.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Both pages give 1938 as the build year, but the 2024 visit reports a 1939 date in the footing cement. The story reports both and does not settle it.

notes_for_editor: Two pages plus the FFLA list; both pages agree on 1938 and 1958. The 1939 footing date is a disagreement the story reports as is. The two CCC-era names are left out on purpose: they are private individuals whom the source could not identify. Access is not stated (the page says hike-in); no access level is recorded. The existing photo on the record is from idahofirelookouts.com and is not new. A second search for Bussel timed out and returned nothing.
